shared.errorBody: The data did not load. Check that the local emulators are running, then try again.

welcome.explanation: One health worker hands a mother's care to another village. She decides what is shared, and she can stop sharing at any time.

start.title: Who are you?
start.subtitle: Choose the option that matches you. You can switch later.
start.workerBody: ASHA or ANM — see your mothers, record visits and hand over care.
start.motherTitle: I am a mother or family member
start.motherBody: See your visits, your health worker and the consent you gave.

auth.workerSubtitle: Log in with your phone number, or register your account.
auth.motherSubtitle: Log in with the phone number your ASHA registered.
auth.workerPhoneHint: Use the number registered with the health programme.
auth.motherPhoneHint: Use the number your ASHA recorded when she registered you.
auth.demoNote: Demo numbers use the fixed code {{code}}.
auth.offlineHint: The sign-in service is not reachable, so the demo code {{code}} is being used.
auth.errorSend: The code could not be sent. Please try again.
auth.errorCode: That code did not work. Please check and try again.
auth.codeHint: The emulator issued code {{code}} for this number.
auth.errorWorkerNotFound: No health worker is registered with this number. Use the Register tab to create an account.
auth.errorMotherNotFound: No record was found for this number. Ask your ASHA to register you.
auth.errorUnauthorizedDomain: This domain is not authorised for sign-in. Contact the administrator.
auth.errorTooManyRequests: Too many sign-in attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
auth.errorPhoneUsed: This number is already registered. Log in instead.
auth.registerHint: Your account is stored locally in this prototype. No real data is collected.
auth.errorRegister: The account could not be created. Please try again.
auth.registeredNotice: Account created. Enter your phone number to log in.
auth.motherRegisterNote: Mothers are registered by their ASHA. If your number is not recognised, ask your ASHA to add it.

demo.title: Demo tools
demo.hint: Jump to a synthetic account for a demonstration. This is not part of the care workflow.
demo.switchNote: All records are synthetic. Switching signs you out of the current account.
demo.error: Could not sign in to that demo account.
demo.simulateOn: On — the app behaves as if there is no signal
demo.simulateOfflineHint: Demo only: forces offline mode so you can show how the app works without a signal.
demo.simulateTimeHint: Ages every waiting request past the overdue limit and sends the overdue messages.
demo.simulateTimeError: Could not simulate time. Check that the emulators are running.
demo.loadConfirm: Load seed data into Firestore? This will overwrite existing data.

worker.title: My mothers
worker.subtitle: Everyone in your village, plus mothers accepted into your care.
worker.incomingHint: Consent has been recorded for a mother moving here. Open her card to review, then accept.
worker.noDatedMilestone: No milestone with a date yet
worker.emptyBody: No mother is registered in this village. Register the first one to open her journey card.
worker.auditNote: Every change is recorded with who made it and when.

register.title: Register a mother
register.subtitle: These details are stored once and shared only with her consent.
register.name: Name
register.phoneHint: She uses this number to log in and see her own visits.
register.hint: Only these details are stored. Nothing is interpreted or scored.
register.errorName: Please enter a name of at least 2 characters.
register.errorPhoneUsed: This number is already in use in the demo data.
register.errorMonth: Please choose the expected delivery month.
register.errorSave: The mother could not be saved. Please try again.

journey.title: Journey card
journey.missingBody: This mother is not in the demo data. Go back and choose another.
journey.noAccessBody: This mother is not in your care. The sending worker records her consent first, and the receiving worker must accept before her card is opened to them.
journey.milestoneHint: Placeholder plan — the final milestone names and schedule come from the clinical lead.
journey.noCardBody: This mother has no journey card in the data.
journey.readonlyAcceptBody: You can read her summary now. Accept the handover to start adding visits to her card.
journey.handoverWaitingBody: {{name}} in {{village}} has been asked to accept her care.
journey.youCareBody: You are her current health worker. You can add visits and update milestones.
journey.readonlyHeadTitle: She is with another village now
journey.readonlyHeadBody: Her care was accepted by {{name}} in {{village}}. You can still see her card and activity.
journey.revokedBody: She withdrew consent and is back with {{village}}.
journey.keepHistory: Entries stay in this log. Nothing is deleted, and a correction keeps the earlier version.
journey.noVisitsBody: Visits you add appear here with who entered them and when.
journey.saveError: Could not save. Please try again.
journey.noActivity: No consent or handover activity yet.

handover.title: Record consent to move
handover.workerPlaceholder: No health worker in this village
handover.explain1: Her name, home village and preferred language.
handover.explain2: Her journey card: the milestones recorded as done, the next dated milestone, and the visit log.
handover.explain3: Nothing else is shared. She can withdraw this consent at any time.
handover.wordingNote: Consent wording is a placeholder for review with the programme team.
handover.consentLabel: {{name}} has given her consent to share the details above.
handover.noConsentNote: Without her consent, no handover is created and no data is shared.
handover.errorConsent: Tick the consent box to continue.
handover.errorSave: The handover could not be recorded. Please try again.
handover.alreadyTitle: A handover is already in progress
handover.alreadyBody: There is already a pending or accepted handover for this mother.

mother.title: My visits
mother.subtitle: Your health worker keeps this up to date.
mother.readonly: This screen is for viewing only. Only you can withdraw your consent.
mother.withdrawConfirmBody: Your details will no longer be shared with {{village}}. Your own health worker keeps your record.
mother.withdrawnBody: Your record is only with {{village}} now.
mother.withdrawError: Could not withdraw consent. Please try again.
mother.noCardBody: Your health worker will add visits here.
mother.notFoundBody: Ask your ASHA to check the number registered for you.

messages.motherIntro: These are the visits recorded for you. Your health team's message will appear here.
messages.motherNextEmpty: No next visit date is recorded yet.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emptyBody: When a handover starts, is accepted or is withdrawn, the message appears here.
notifications.handover_requested: {{name}} is moving from {{fromVillage}} to {{toVillage}}. Handover requested.
notifications.consent_withdrawn: Consent withdrawn for {{name}}. She is back with {{villageName}}.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp preview
whatsapp.subtitle: What the reminder message would look like. Nothing is sent.
whatsapp.message: MaaSetu: {{name}} is moving from {{fromVillage}} to {{toVillage}}. Handover requested by {{workerName}}.
whatsapp.noHealthDetails: The message has no health details and no personal data beyond the names above.
whatsapp.noMotherBody: Start a handover first. This screen only shows a mock of the message.

notFound.heading: Page not found
notFound.body: That page does not exist. Go back to the start.

safety.assistive: Assistive only — stores, shares with consent, notifies and reminds. It never diagnoses, scores risk or advises treatment.
safety.content: Care-plan text is pre-written and clinician-approved.

hint.online: Connected. Changes go to the server straight away.
hint.slow: The connection is slow. Screens may take longer to open.
hint.offline: No connection. You can keep working — changes stay on this phone and sync later.

offline.consentQueuedBody: Her consent is recorded here, but it has not been sent yet. {{village}} will not see it until this phone syncs.
offline.acceptQueuedBody: This handover is waiting to sync. She stays with her current worker until the server confirms it.
offline.withdrawQueuedBody: Her consent will be withdrawn when this phone syncs. Until then her record is still shared.
offline.startQueuedBody: The consent is recorded on this phone. The receiving worker will not see it until it syncs.
offline.rejectedAcceptBody: Her consent was withdrawn before this accept reached the server, so the handover was not applied. Nothing was changed.
offline.rejectedHandoverBody: The server refused this handover because another one is already active. Open her card to see the current situation.
offline.visitMissingBody: This visit no longer exists on the server. Nothing was changed.
offline.smsBody: The receiving worker could not be reached in the app. Preview the message you would send from your own phone.

qr.title: Offline summary
qr.subtitle: This code carries a short summary of her care. It works with no connection.
qr.codeAlt: QR code with the mother's offline summary
qr.qrFailed: The code could not be drawn. Use the text version below.
qr.none: No milestone is recorded as done yet.
qr.contains: Only her name, home village and the milestones recorded as done with their dates. No visit notes.
qr.offlineShare: Show this code to the receiving worker. She can read it without a connection.
qr.scanSubtitle: Paste the code shown on the other phone. It works with no connection.
qr.scanBody: Paste a code to see the summary. It stays unverified until it is checked.
qr.invalid: That code could not be read. Check that you copied all of it.
qr.summaryBody: This summary came from another phone and has not been checked with the server.
qr.verifiedBody: This summary matches her record on the server.
qr.mismatchTitle: This does not match the server.
qr.mismatchBody: Trust the server version of her record.
qr.verifyOffline: Still offline. This summary stays unverified.

sms.title: SMS preview
sms.subtitle: What you would send from your own phone. Nothing is sent by this app.
sms.whenUnreachable: The receiving worker could not be reached in the app. This is the message you would send from your own phone.
sms.message: MaaSetu: {{name}} is moving from {{fromVillage}} to {{toVillage}}. Consent recorded by {{workerName}}. Please accept the handover.
sms.noHealthDetails: The message has no health details and no personal data beyond the names above.
sms.noMotherBody: Start a handover first. This screen only shows a mock of the message.

conflict.title: Two versions kept
conflict.body: This record was changed somewhere else while this phone was offline. Both versions are kept with who wrote them and when.
conflict.kept: Both versions are stored. Nothing was overwritten.

tracker.title: Care move
tracker.subtitle: Each step of the move, from consent to the first visit.
tracker.notSentYetBody: Her consent is saved on this phone. This step is complete when the phone reaches the server.
tracker.overdueBody: Nobody needs to hurry. {{village}} has been asked to accept.
tracker.withdrawnBody: She withdrew her consent on {{when}}. The move stopped there.
tracker.motherWithdrawnBody: You withdrew your consent on {{when}}. The move stopped there.

stage.seen: Seen by the new health worker
stage.firstVisit: First visit in the new village

motherStage.planned: You gave permission to share your details
motherStage.sent: Your details were sent to the new village
motherStage.seen: Your new health worker has seen your details
motherStage.accepted: Your new health worker has accepted your care
motherStage.firstVisit: Your first visit in the new village is recorded
